intent: original static environment composition; no input/reference images
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original pre-rendered 2D action-RPG outdoor environment plate for Hollowbane, STATIC ART-DIRECTION REVIEW at actual gameplay scale. Create one finished coherent environment, not a design sheet, screenshot of UI, or technical demo.
Canvas: landscape 16:10, ideally 1536x960 or 1280x800. Fill the complete rectangular canvas with the world. Fixed orthographic axonometric camera, about 30 degrees above the ground, ground axes slope approximately plus/minus 0.5 (2:1 diamond). NO horizon, NO sky, NO perspective vanishing point, NO miniature floating island or diorama cutout. The ground continues beyond every image edge.
Scene: one original dark-fantasy abandoned field at a natural woodland boundary. A single irregular worn earthen footpath enters from the lower-left foreground, passes through a modest grassy opening in the central middle ground, curves beside a small ruined dry-stone enclosure in the upper-right middle ground, and narrows into the rear woodland. The ruin is one low L-shaped broken enclosure corner made of weathered gray-brown fieldstone, about waist to head height at its tallest surviving corner, with a few adjoining fallen stones, moss at its base, and one partly collapsed threshold. This is a small grounded ruin, not a castle, church, archway, monument or gigantic building. Sparse storytelling: an old split timber half buried beside the wall and a patch of worn soil at the threshold. No other landmarks.
World-first composition: natural uneven groups of mature oak-like trees with varied crooked trunks and broad irregular crowns create a connected boundary in the upper portion and side edges, not a ring or evenly scattered individual trees. One darker foreground trunk/root mass and cropped branches at lower right overlap nearby ground. Farther boundary trees are quieter and a little lower contrast. Keep a readable central playable-looking opening but not a huge empty bare clearing. Preserve a continuous view of the path. The trees should feel approximately 3-5 times a future 90-pixel person's visible height at 1280x800. Avoid overlarge panoramic trees that swallow the whole scene.
Terrain is the main subject: interlocking muted olive and deep brown-green grasses, patches of exposed damp dark brown earth, a narrow worn path 1.5-3 future human heights in width, small clumps of yellowed grass. Track edges are irregular and infiltrated by grass, with flattened grass becoming soil gradually. Near tree trunks show exposed roots, compacted darker earth and leaf litter. Near the stone wall show scattered pebbles, moss and worn mineral earth before blending into grass. Every prop has a believable footing and contact shadow. Large and middle-sized material forms organize the scene; tiny detail is subordinate. No hard geometric terrain borders, no repeated tile stamps, no identical crowns, no uniformly distributed noise, no checkerboards, no cobblestone blanket.
Style: grounded and restrained hand-finished pre-rendered game art, sober late-1990s/early-2000s dark-fantasy atmosphere with restrained modernization; believable natural materials, subdued granular pigment, legible large silhouettes and medium-scale texture at 1280x800. Finished playable environment image rather than a loose painterly concept illustration. NOT cartoon, NOT glossy mobile game, NOT photographic drone shot, NOT pixel-art grid. All surfaces share compatible edge sharpness and apparent resolution. Original composition and artwork only; do not reproduce any specific existing game's map, objects or textures.
Lighting and palette: one broad cool-neutral overcast key from upper left; shadows fall softly toward lower right. Restrained muted olive, umber, charcoal, gray-brown stone, small desaturated dry-grass highlights. Deep but readable wooded shadows, coherent exposure. No cinematic god rays, excessive fog, glowing mushrooms, colored rim lights, glossy wet highlights or dramatic vignette. Materials must remain readable without bright saturation. No bloom.
Do not include people, monsters, animals, characters, weapons, combat, UI, text, labels, borders, watermarks, logos, decorative frame, sky, mountains or distant scenery. Do not copy protected assets or a known layout. One unified image, not a collage of separate sprites.
